name: D2 | Cảnh báo bệnh nặng cho Farmer

parameters.query:
UPDATE reports 
SET ai_analysis = '{{ $json.tinh_trang }} | {{ $json.muc_do }} | {{ $json.ten_benh }} | {{ $json.khuyen_nghi }}',
    ai_severity = '{{ $json.muc_do }}',
    ai_disease = '{{ $json.ten_benh }}',
    status = 'reviewing'
WHERE id = {{ $json.report_id }};

SELECT 
  r.id AS report_id, r.title, r.ai_analysis, r.ai_severity, r.ai_disease, r.field_id,
  u.id AS farmer_id, u.full_name, u.telegram_chat_id,
  f.name AS field_name, f.location
FROM reports r
JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id
LEFT JOIN fields f ON f.id = r.field_id
WHERE r.id = {{ $('Parse kết quả AI').item.json.report_id }}

INSERT INTO alerts (alert_type, category, severity, title, description, field_id, status, created_at)
VALUES (
  'agriculture',
  'disease',
  '{{ $json.ai_severity }}',
  'Cảnh báo bệnh: {{ $json.ai_disease }} - {{ $json.field_name }}',
  '{{ $json.ai_analysis }}',
  {{ $json.field_id }},
  'new',
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id, title, severity;
